question: Can we safely and usefully begin NON-score-bearing engineering qualification (S1a)?
note: Generated from the repository state; deterministic (no clock, no absolute paths). S1a is non-score-bearing engineering qualification with no H-1 Hall discharge; S1A_READY never schedules S1 (N4, separate gate, not read here) and never satisfies an N4 condition. A DRAFT / PROPOSED artifact never satisfies a condition; nothing is inferred.

relation.N4: N4 (fo_s1_readiness_gate) decides whether S1 (S1a no-plasma calibration + S1b Hall-on re-mount qualification per lane 25 s1_plan) may be scheduled after LOCK-1; it stays S1_NOT_READY 0/8 and is not modified. S1a here is the engineering path the owner opened in A3: it may begin before LOCK-1, never takes a Hall-on H-1 reading, is never score-bearing, and never satisfies an N4 condition by itself. Its records can later become N4 evidence only through the N4 artifacts (e.g. the S1-C4 capability-demonstration record from S1a calibration measurements, accepted by the owner under the frozen S1-C5 plan).
relation.W4_capability_demonstration: W4 (fo_capability_demo_prep) prepares CD-01..CD-07 and the record format for the N4 S1-C4 measured-capability artifact. S1A_READY is the point from which those demonstrations may be executed on actual hardware as non-score-bearing engineering qualification; their results become the S1-C4 record only when the owner accepts them against a frozen S1-C5 calibration plan (N4).
relation.W5: S1a produces the first H-1 data (registration inputs). The firewall keeps them in custody until LOCK-H1 and forbids every held-out output in S1a.

milestones.A: Schedule enabler only: starting engineering qualification early shortens the path to S1 -> LOCK-2 -> the controlled HW-0 / HW-RF / HW-ECR experiment in which the conditions of a conditional selection are demonstrated. The gate selects, ranks or eliminates nothing.
milestones.to_next: Milestone B needs N4 S1_READY, S1 executed, LOCK-2, Phase 1-3 data, the W5 pre-registration frozen and scored and an admitted Hall transport closure (credible set empty today, gate 3 FAIL). Milestone C additionally needs mass, power, thermal, life, startup, cathode and mission closure integrated.
